name: Barometric Pressure's buff tooltip amount is sent to the caster's client (#10787)
contract: Barometric Pressure 803563 shows "Slowing the movement speed of enemies within $a1 yds by ${-($w1)}% and
reducing their casting speed by ${-($w1)}%" on the caster's buff, and the client reads $w1 from the
SMSG_ASCENSION_AURA_AMOUNT packet (slot 0). Effect 0 is SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AREA_AURA_ENEMY with aura 65 and a
base of -21, so the caster's own aura holds an amount of -20 but never applies that effect to itself; the
packet builder skipped effects the application did not carry and sent 0, so the buff read as a zero modifier.
The packet now sends the amount of enemy-area effects as well. aura_amount confirms the server-side amount of
-20 and sent_aura_amount reads what the caster's session was actually sent: -20 for effect 0 and 0 for the
